name: Digital Fortress Lynnwood

profile.reading: Digital Fortress is a colocation data center operator, a portfolio company of Chirisa Investments. This specific facility level reading supplements an earlier facility level pass already on file for this operator, which confirmed Lynnwood, Washington, facility code LYN, described on the operators own site as North Seattle, as one of the companys locations via a quote request form, though a dedicated Lynnwood facility page on the operators own site returned a not found error both in that earlier pass and again this session. A facility specific aggregator listing dedicated to this operator in Lynnwood gives 4200 194th Street Southwest as the street address, which this session applies given the operators own confirmed presence in this market and this aggregators dedicated, operator specific listing.
profile.research_note: Facility specific seeding pass 2026-09-02, batch 74 (Digital Fortress missing-address campaign): applied 4200 194th Street Southwest, Lynnwood, sourced from a dedicated facility specific aggregator listing for this exact operator, since the operators own dedicated Lynnwood page continues to 404.
sources_tried: This operators own homepage (confirmed Lynnwood as a market via a quote request form, dedicated facility page 404s), and a facility specific aggregator listing dedicated to this operator in Lynnwood, which supplied a street address

capacity_absent_because: the operator publishes a regional index rather than a page for this building, so there is no per-facility figure to cite
